branches.title: Branches
branches.body: Which office a record belongs to. A branch is a label and a filter — it grants nothing and hides nothing.

branches.codeHint: Short, and shown where the full name will not fit.
branches.none: No branches. Every record carries none, which is the correct state for a business with one office.
branches.failed: That did not save. Try again.

ticketing.quickRepliesHint: Shared saved text agents can insert into a reply. Plain text — no variables.
ticketing.prioritiesFixed: Priorities are fixed at Low · Normal · High · Urgent and are not editable here.

quickReply.listLabel: Quick replies, in the order agents see them
quickReply.emptyBody: Saved replies appear in the agent's reply box in this order.
quickReply.bothLanguages: Both languages are required. An agent who only reads Arabic cannot use an English-only reply.

serviceLevels.targetsHint: In minutes of working time, per priority. Weekends, holidays and the hours outside the working day do not count.
serviceLevels.workingHoursHint: A day with no hours is treated as closed.
serviceLevels.holidaysHint: One date per line, as YYYY-MM-DD.
serviceLevels.atRiskHint: A ticket is flagged before it breaches, at this share of its target.

email.mailboxHint: The mailbox incoming tickets are read from.
email.acknowledgementHint: Sent to the customer when a ticket is created from their email.

email.logPlaceholder: Sent and failed messages will be listed here once email is live.
email.channelHint: Whether the application sends and receives email at all.

email.logEmptyBody: Attempts will appear here once the channel is used.
email.inboundHint: Where a customer's email arrives, and what to do when one cannot be read.
email.quarantineHint: Mail that could not be turned into a ticket. Nothing here has reached an agent.
email.quarantineEmptyBody: Every message so far became a ticket or a reply.
email.replayHint: Feeds the message back through, as if it had just arrived.
email.replayFailed: It still could not be read.

platform.attachmentTypesHint: One MIME type per line. A type that is not listed is refused on upload.
platform.defaultLocaleHint: Used for people who have not chosen one.
platform.brandingHint: Three values, and no more. There is no application name, no separate sign-in logo, no palette, no typography control and no custom CSS.
platform.brandReach: The brand reaches four surfaces: the customer portal, the public web form, the live-chat widget and outbound email. It does not reach the staff workspace or this console — those keep the product’s own design system, and there is no setting that changes that.
platform.brandContrastNote: A colour that fails WCAG AA contrast against the surfaces it will sit on is refused when you save it, with the measured ratio. It is never accepted with a warning.

auditLog.placeholder: Configuration changes are already recorded with who made them. The searchable log arrives with the audit story.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.deleteCategory: This will delete the category “{name}”. Tickets already filed under it keep their history, but no new ticket can use it.
confirm.deleteQuickReply: This will delete the quick reply “{name}” for every agent.

blocked.cannotDelete: Cannot delete: {count} tickets still use it.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.hint: The answers we have written down. Publishing puts one in front of people — and it can never be deleted afterwards, only archived.
knowledge.needsACategory: Create a category before writing an article — every article is filed in exactly one.
knowledge.loadFailed: The article list could not be loaded.
knowledge.deleteBlocked: Published articles cannot be deleted — archive it instead.

knowledge.bodyHint: Formatting, lists, links and images are kept. Scripts, embeds and styles are removed.
knowledge.notWrittenHint: This article has no {locale} version yet. Writing one is optional — an article in a single language is complete.

autoAssignment.title: Auto-assignment
autoAssignment.hint: One line per rule: a category or a department, and where its tickets go. There is no ordering and no conditions — each source maps to exactly one target.

autoAssignment.loadFailed: The rules could not be loaded.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.immutabilityNote: Entries are written once and never changed or removed — not by an administrator, not through this screen, and not through the API. That is what makes the log worth reading after an incident.
